tool.title: Publish a built site to gh-pages as a full replace
tool.description: Lay a built `_site` onto a `gh-pages` checkout as a FULL REPLACE and push it, keeping the open pull requests' staging previews: each attempt re-reads the branch, re-runs restore-staging and keep-shared-payloads against what is on it now, replaces the tree, commits `docs(gh-pages): site from <sha>` and pushes. A rejected push is rebuilt, never rebased (a rebase would re-apply the replace over a preview a sibling just deployed), up to three attempts. A restore that cannot read the branch stops the publish. A site that matches the branch is a no-op, not a failure. It publishes and does not verify: the workflow's verify step runs after it.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: The built site to publish (env SITE).

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: restore-staging's record file; keep-shared-payloads keeps its directory at `<state>.keep` (env STATE).

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: The commit the site was built from, named in the pages commit message (env COMMIT_SHA).

inputs.name: pagesDir
inputs.description: A git checkout whose `origin` holds the `gh-pages` branch (env PAGES_DIR).

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: `published on attempt <n>`, or `nothing to publish`; any other exit is a publish that did not happen.

selection.when: The deploy step of a site publish: after the site is built and checked, to replace the live `gh-pages` tree without dropping the previews on it.
selection.limits: A full replace of the whole branch. A branch preview (`branches/<branch>/`) is published by the staging route, which replaces only its own directory.
selection.cost: A shallow fetch, a copy of the site and a push, repeated on a lost race.

remedies.none: The branch is read and pushed on the git host; with no host there is nothing to publish to.
